question.text: PMS services in India can be offered ONLY by:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI registration is mandatory to offer Portfolio Management Services in India. The Trap: Professional qualifications (e.g. CA) or being a listed/banking entity do not by themselves authorise a person to offer PMS - the gating requirement is SEBI registration. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-A PMS Distributors workbook (Sep 2025), page 92.
